$comment: Accepted advisories for scripts/audit-check.mjs (pnpm audit --prod, gate >= high). Every entry needs the GHSA id, the package, the reason it is acceptable and an expiry date: after that date CI goes red again until the entry is renewed with a fresh justification or the dependency is fixed. Entries below the gate are listed for documentation only.

entries.reason: Our own uuid is >= 11.1.1; the remaining copies (8.3.2 / 9.0.1 / 11.1.0) are pinned by @apollo/server and @azure/msal-node. The flaw is in v3/v5/v6 with a caller-supplied buffer; those libraries only generate v4 ids.
